tools.name: proxy_call
tools.description: Make an HTTP call credentialed with a stored secret. You provide only the secret KEY NAME (e.g. STRIPE_KEY) and the target URL; the value is injected outside this tool boundary and NEVER appears in tool input or output. Only the upstream API response returns. Use secrets_list first to discover key names.

injections.description: Map of injection_spec to secret KEY NAME (never values). Specs: "bearer", "basic", "header:X-Name", "query:param", "body:json.path", "form:field". Example: {"bearer": "STRIPE_KEY"} or {"header:X-Api-Key": "API_KEY"}. Cloud mode supports bearer/header/body/form; basic and query need local mode.

body.description: Request body as a string (JSON for body:/form: injections)

agent_id.description: Declared agent identity for audit attribution

environment.description: Asserts the expected environment (cloud: must match the pinned identity scope; does not re-scope the token)

project.description: Project name/ID for context (resolves workspace identity)

tools.name: proxy_status
tools.description: Reachability of the local proxy and cloud resolver (no secrets involved).

tools.name: secrets_list
tools.description: List secret KEY NAMES for a project (values NEVER returned). Falls back to local .env names without a login.

project.description: Project name or ID (defaults to current context)

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: secrets_set
tools.description: Create/update one secret. The value travels inside this single call and is AES-256-GCM-encrypted before transit; the server stores ciphertext only. Confirm with the human first when the value came from chat.

value.description: Secret value. Travels inside this one call; the server stores only AES-256-GCM ciphertext. Delete this message afterwards.

project.description: Project name or ID (defaults to current context)

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: secrets_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a secret key (cloud + local .env). Requires confirm:true.

project.description: Project name or ID (defaults to current context)

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: secrets_pull
tools.description: Download cloud secrets into the local .env file (0600). Values are decrypted in-process and written to disk, never returned. Requires a workspace key or local mode.

project.description: Project name or ID (defaults to current context)

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: secrets_push
tools.description: Upload local .env secrets to the cloud (encrypted before transit). Requires a workspace key or local mode.

project.description: Project name or ID (defaults to current context)

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: secrets_diff
tools.description: Compare local .env key names against cloud (changed values detected only with a workspace key or local mode). Names only, never values.

project.description: Project name or ID (defaults to current context)

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: project_list
tools.description: List projects visible to the login (marks the context-selected one).

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: project_create
tools.description: Create a project in the active workspace and bind it locally. Always confirm the name with the human first.

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: project_use
tools.description: Select a project by name and bind it locally (writes .agentsecrets/project.json + pins defaults).

name.description: Project name to select and bind locally

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: project_update
tools.description: Rename a project or change its description (syncs local binding).

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: project_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a project. Requires confirm:true and human confirmation in chat.

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List workspaces (fresh from API when logged in, else offline login cache). Marks the selected one.

tools.name: workspace_create
tools.description: Create a team workspace (mints + wraps a data key like the CLI). Always confirm the name with the human first.

tools.name: workspace_switch
tools.description: Pin the active workspace for subsequent calls (human confirmation in chat first).

tools.name: workspace_members
tools.description: List workspace members (id, email, role, status). Metadata only.

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: agent_list
tools.description: List registered agent identities with token METADATA (never values). Prefer auth_use_identity to select one.

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current context)

project.description: Project name or ID — limits to project-scoped agents

tools.name: agent_delete
tools.description: Revoke all active tokens and delete an agent registration. Requires confirm:true and human confirmation.

confirm.description: Required: revokes all tokens and deletes the registration

tools.name: agent_token_issue
tools.description: Issue a token for an agent AND pin it as this workspace bridge identity (stored 0600, value never shown). Prefer auth_use_identity for guided setup.

agent.description: Agent name or registration ID (areg_...) to issue for

environment.description: Environment scope (defaults to active; binds token scope)

expires_in.description: TTL e.g. "30d" (server applies rotation policy caps)

tools.name: logs_list
tools.description: Query cloud audit logs (metadata only: who, what, where, outcome — never values). Filter by agent, recency, limit.

project.description: Project name or ID (defaults to current context)

tools.name: logs_summary
tools.description: Aggregate audit activity (totals, unique domains/credentials, blocked/redacted counts).

tools.name: logs_detail
tools.description: Fetch one audit log entry by ID. Metadata only.

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Inspect bridge state: mode, logins, pinned workload identities + scopes, next setup step. Start here.

tools.name: auth_login
tools.description: Connect with zero pre-configuration: browser OAuth flow (returns a URL for the human), or terminal token-file instructions.

mode.description: oauth: browser flow (default, tries OAuth then falls back to instructions). token-file: terminal export instructions only.

tools.name: auth_logout
tools.description: Wipe the bridge session and (by default) revoke pinned bridge tokens server-side.

revoke.description: Also revoke pinned bridge tokens server-side (best-effort, needs login)

tools.name: auth_use_identity
tools.description: Pin a workload identity for a workspace: picks an agent registration, issues a scoped bridge token (stored, never shown). Completes setup; repeat per workspace.

agent.description: Agent name or registration ID. Omit to list candidates / use the single one.

workspace.description: Workspace name or ID (defaults to current/pinned/single)

environment.description: Environment scope for the issued token (defaults to active)
